description: This file contains a report script for 'Pending Sales Order Items for Purchase Request' in an ERP system, defining functions to generate report columns and data based on sales orders, material requests, and product bundles.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate report columns and data.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the structure and labels of report columns.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches and processes sales order, material request, and product bundle data to generate report rows.

methods.name: get_items_with_product_bundle
methods.description: Retrieves item codes that are part of product bundles based on input list.

methods.name: get_packed_items
methods.description: Retrieves packed item details for given sales orders and maps bundled items.
